description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of question types across three difficulty levels: easy, medium, and hard, as indicated by the labels above each chart. Each chart contains four slices representing different categories: N+K+, N-K+, N-K-, and N+K-. The “easy” chart shows slices labeled with approximately 40.6% light green, 45.9% yellow, 10.1% orange, and 3.3% red. The “medium” chart displays slices with approximately 44.6% light green, 44.3% yellow, 7.2% orange, and 3.9% red. The “hard” chart shows slices with approximately 36.2% light green, 20.1% yellow, 7.0% orange, and 3.3% red. Each chart includes percentage labels displayed inside the slices, and a legend identifying the color-coding for each category. The slices within each chart appear to be ordered from largest to smallest based on their proportional size.
